continuity_scope: Monster Hunter Wilds base game, North American Capcom Town Store/Steam product witness, released 28 February 2025. This is a base-game product/system audit, not a franchise-wide Monster Hunter pass. It excludes prior titles, other platforms/localizations, cosmetic DLC, post-launch title updates, events, crossovers, the announced Monster Hunter Wilds: Ascendance expansion, and all individual player save/online sessions. The official Monster Hunter Wilds character page was inaccessible to this research environment; no NPC biography is inferred from unavailable content.

work_or_witnesses.edition: North American Capcom Town Store base-game product listing for Steam, marked 2025.02.28; selected platform/product witness.
Capcom USA official news post, 11 April 2025; used only to corroborate named NPC appearances and title-update separation, not as a character profile.

work_or_witnesses.edition: Capcom Town official expansion announcement; used only for the future-expansion boundary.

coverage_rule: Terms-only base-game audit. The selected accessible first-party product witness names Nata in the setup and mentions supporting expedition members, while a Capcom USA news post shows Alma and Olivia; neither supplies a direct claim-level profile sufficient for stable dramatic-character records in this pass. The official character page returned a 403 block in the research environment, so no character or relationship records are made. The player Hunter and Palico are explicitly avatar/customization systems, not nodes. Named/title-designated NPCs may be added only from a separately verifiable official profile page; monsters/species, weapons, guild roles, items, locales, hunting/crafting systems, and mechanics remain terms/dimensions.
omissions: The player-created Hunter and custom Palico; Nata, Alma, Olivia, and all other named or title-designated NPCs, because the selected accessible evidence lacks a direct claim-level official profile for each individual and the official character page was unavailable to this audit.
All monster/species entities, weapon classes, armor, materials, guild roles, Seikrets, items, locales, camps, ecology cycles, quests, crafting, events, and mechanics as character nodes.

All Monster Hunter titles other than the selected Wilds base product; every localization/platform implementation; cosmetic DLC, Title Updates, live events/crossovers, announced Ascendance expansion, and player-created/online session continuities.
content_cautions: The official product centers hunting, tracking, defeating, harvesting from, and crafting from powerful monsters, amid environmental peril and human/monster conflict. It contains fantasy violence and may involve animal-like creature harm, harvesting, weapons, and ecological disruption.

Player-created Hunter/Palico appearance, equipment, weapons, hunt decisions, crafting, multiplayer partners, captured/defeated targets, and session outcomes are variable. This audit does not turn a player avatar or hunt result into a shared dramatic identity or fixed story outcome.
uncertainties: Capcom's official Wilds character page was blocked by a 403 response in both browser and direct retrieval during this pass. Accessible official material establishes names Nata, Alma, and Olivia only in setup/screenshot contexts, not adequate profile claims; they are deliberately omitted rather than reconstructed from memory or fan sources.

The current Capcom Town listing includes later cosmetic DLC references and warns that content/release dates can change and some content requires latest game version. Those later materials are not treated as evidence for the selected February 2025 base state.

The North American Steam store witness is not a comparison of PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, other regional scripts, or later platform patches. Localized names, dialogue, cosmetics, and implementations remain unreviewed.
evidence_basis: Capcom Town official product documentation establishes the selected date/region/product, Forbidden Lands premise, Nata setup, ecology cycles, hunting/crafting loop, base-versus-cosmetic-DLC boundary, and current-content caveat. Capcom USA official news establishes that later Free Title Update 2 content is separate and shows named NPC appearances without profile-level claims. Capcom Town's official Ascendance reveal establishes a future expansion boundary. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, database, guide, datamine, or player session is used.
